s2.ptxt: Apply Denso No. 50 grease to the starter planetary gears, the flange pins of the planetary shaft and the inside of the planetary bushing reduction portion.
Install the 3 starter planetary gears to the flange pins of the planetary shaft.
Secure the starter commutator end frame assembly with aluminum plates in between.

item.ptxt: Do not damage the starter commutator end frame assembly.

s2.ptxt: Apply Denso No. 50 grease to the washer, new snap ring and the bearing insertion area of the armature shaft.
Install the armature shaft to the bearing of the starter commutator end frame assembly.
Install the washer to the armature shaft.
Using SST, install a new snap ring.

item.ptxt: Securely install the snap ring into the groove of the armature shaft.
Be careful when installing the snap ring, as it expands easily.

s2.ptxt: Check the dimension of the snap ring shown in the illustration.

atten4.ptxt: If the dimension is at or above the limit, replace it with a new snap ring.

s-1.ptxt: Install Starter Commutator End Frame Cover

s2.ptxt: Install the starter commutator end frame cover to the starter commutator end frame assembly.
Align the rotation stopper of the starter armature plate with the punched protrusion on the inner circumference of the starter yoke assembly, and install the armature plate.

atten3.ptxt: Check that the rotation stopper of the starter armature plate is securely fitted into the inner embossed portion of the starter yoke assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Install Starter Commutator End Frame Assembly

s2.ptxt: Align the lead wire rubber of the starter commutator end frame assembly with the cutout of the starter yoke, and install the starter commutator end frame assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Assemble carefully, as the magnet of the starter yoke assembly attracts the starter armature assembly and the magnet may crack.

s2.ptxt: Align the punched protrusion on the outer circumference of the starter yoke assembly with the cutout of the starter motor terminal kit, and install the starter yoke assembly.
Apply Denso No. 50 grease to the outer circumference and hook of the plunger.
Securely engage the hook of the plunger with the lever.
Insert the return spring into the plunger, and install the repair service starter kit.
Connect the terminal C harness with the nut.
